name: bit_and_waits_for_both
reason: Wait for both values; either input then activates. Equal ordinary results still tick.

name: sample_only_on_signal
reason: Only signal is active; its payload is irrelevant. Read the latest valid ts, including a retained value.

name: sample_waits_for_value
reason: An early trigger cannot sample an invalid value. A passive value becoming valid does not trigger. Zero is still a signal tick.

name: dedup_zero_and_idle
reason: First valid zero emits. Suppress equal values, retain history over idle cycles, emit a return to zero.
